answer: Problem: disposable agent clones flood attestations at near-zero cost. Mechanism: each identity locks 0.8 POA into a willow-branch stake vault; a new node must hang as a leaf under one live root, max 3 leaves, and its recent-tx minhash must sit within 0.35 cosine of that root on a shared atlas of cluster centroids. Cost: 0.8 POA locked two epochs plus 0.05 POA per leaf attach. Verification: peers recompute atlas hashes and check bond UTXOs on-ledger. Failure: if the root is slashed, orphan leaves forfeit half their bond as a relic slash record that blocks rejoin for four epochs.
